<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Standard">
  <!ENTITY % ext "SYSTEM 'ext.dtd'">
  %ext;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <!ENTITY cdata_ent "<![CDATA[Nested CDATA-like text & symbols]]>">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/ns/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Main inventory catalog containing internal entities and processing instructions -->
  <?catalog-info version="2.0" status="active"?>
  <item>
    &base; &cata_ent;
    <![CDATA[
      Raw CDATA block containing markup <tag> and entities &base; which should not expand.
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "EntityValue">
  <!ENTITY ref "&ent; Expanded">
  <!NOTATION n SYSTEM "file://notation">
]>
<?target-pi data="processing-instruction-content"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment covering DTD behavior and entity expansion limits -->
  <sub:child>
    <?sub:pi attr="value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Another CDATA block with <>&'" characters inside namespace context.
    ]]>
    &ref;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
<document xmlns="http://schema.org/doc" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comprehensive test case incorporating multiple namespace declarations -->
  <section xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <?xml-pipeline step="validate"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Embedded CDATA section with CDATA close marker check ]]>
    ]]>
    &text;
  </section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE testsuite [
  <!ELEMENT testsuite (case*)>
  <!ELEMENT case (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Val1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Val2">
  <!ENTITY e3 "&e2; Val3">
]>
<?checker-instruction mode="strict"?>
<testsuite xmlns="http://qa.org/test" xmlns:custom="http://qa.org/custom">
  <!-- High recursion potential entity combination test -->
  <custom:case id="1">
    <?custom-meta debug="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA inside a heavily namespaced custom element structure.
    ]]>
    &e3;
  </custom:case>
</testsuite>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY default_setting "on">
  <!NOTATION bin SYSTEM "application/octet-stream">
  <!ENTITY binary_data SYSTEM "data.bin" NDATA bin>
]>
<?config-processor engine="v2"?>
<config xmlns="http://uri.interop.org/config" xmlns:cfg="http://uri.interop.org/config/local">
  <!-- Configuration root with mixed content, PIs, and CDATA blocks -->
  <cfg:setting name="mode">
    <?cfg-action refresh?>
    <![CDATA[
      Configuration CDATA payload: 
      - setting: &default_setting;
      - status: active
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
</config>
```
